caption: The drawing depicts two brown leather hatboxes with an oval shape. The hatbox on the left is shown standing upright with its lid open, revealing an interior lined with blue and white vertical stripes. The exterior features leather panels and a brass-colored lock mechanism on the front. The hatbox on the right is shown with its lid closed and lying horizontally, with a central leather strap secured by a small brass buckle. Both objects are rendered with shading and detail to indicate the texture of the leather and the structure of the boxes. The background is a plain, off-white color.
title: Leather Hat Box
